author: cli
text:
Re-read when the search query was registered. The test's claim is unchanged: every --json query is enumerated here deliberately, so a surface cannot appear without somebody deciding it should. The set gained 'search'.

Adding one query tripped FOUR pins in this repo - this set, the read fence enrolment, the usage text, and the advertised-tools list. That is the three-doors discipline working: a new read surface is not done when it returns data, it is done when it is discoverable, fenced, and documented.
